package tirtc // import "github.com/tangeai/tirtc-client-go/v2"


VARIABLES

var (
	ErrInvalidArgument      = errors.New("tirtc: invalid argument")
	ErrNotInitialized       = errors.New("tirtc: not initialized")
	ErrAuthenticationFailed = errors.New("tirtc: authentication failed")
	ErrTimeout              = errors.New("tirtc: timeout")
	ErrRemoteClosed         = errors.New("tirtc: remote closed")
	ErrTokenExpired         = errors.New("tirtc: token expired")
	ErrAlreadyInitialized   = errors.New("tirtc: already initialized")
	ErrPermissionDenied     = errors.New("tirtc: permission denied")
	ErrInUse                = errors.New("tirtc: resource in use")
	ErrNotStarted           = errors.New("tirtc: not started")
	ErrNotConnected         = errors.New("tirtc: not connected")
	ErrNotBound             = errors.New("tirtc: not bound")
	ErrNotConfigured        = errors.New("tirtc: not configured")
	ErrResourceExhausted    = errors.New("tirtc: resource exhausted")
	ErrLogExport            = errors.New("tirtc: log export failed")
	ErrLogUpload            = errors.New("tirtc: log upload failed")
	ErrUnsupported          = errors.New("tirtc: unsupported")
	ErrUnsupportedFormat    = errors.New("tirtc: unsupported format")
	ErrIO                   = errors.New("tirtc: I/O failed")
	ErrNoFrame              = errors.New("tirtc: no frame")
	ErrNoRecordableMedia    = errors.New("tirtc: no recordable media")
	ErrRecordingOverrun     = errors.New("tirtc: recording overrun")
	ErrClosed               = errors.New("tirtc: closed")
)

FUNCTIONS

func ErrorName(code int32) string
func Init(options InitOptions) error
func Shutdown() error
func UploadLogs() (string, error)

TYPES

type AudioBitstreamFormat uint8

const (
	AudioBitstreamNone AudioBitstreamFormat = iota
	AudioBitstreamG711APacket
	AudioBitstreamAACADTS
	AudioBitstreamAACRawAccessUnit
	AudioBitstreamPCMInt16LEInterleaved
	AudioBitstreamOpusPacket
	AudioBitstreamAMRNBFrame
)
type AudioCodec uint8

const (
	AudioCodecNone  AudioCodec = 0
	AudioCodecG711A AudioCodec = 1
	AudioCodecAAC   AudioCodec = 2
	AudioCodecPCM   AudioCodec = 3
	AudioCodecOpus  AudioCodec = 4
	AudioCodecAMR   AudioCodec = 5
)
type AudioFrame struct {
	Data              []byte
	PTS               time.Duration
	SourceTime        time.Time
	Format            AudioSampleFormat
	SampleRateHz      int
	Channels          int
	SamplesPerChannel int
	Discontinuity     bool
}

type AudioOutput struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}

func NewAudioOutput(options AudioOutputOptions) (*AudioOutput, error)

func (o *AudioOutput) Attach(connection *Conn, streamID uint8) (resultErr error)

func (o *AudioOutput) Close() (resultErr error)

func (o *AudioOutput) Detach() (resultErr error)

func (o *AudioOutput) State() OutputState

type AudioOutputOptions struct {
	AGCLevel       AudioProcessingLevel
	ANSLevel       AudioProcessingLevel
	Buffer         OutputBufferOptions
	OnFrame        func(frame AudioFrame)
	OnStateChanged func(state OutputState)
	OnError        func(err error)
}

type AudioProcessingLevel uint8

const (
	AudioProcessingDisabled AudioProcessingLevel = iota
	AudioProcessingLow
	AudioProcessingMedium
	AudioProcessingHigh
)
type AudioSampleFormat uint8

const (
	AudioSampleNone AudioSampleFormat = iota
	AudioSampleInt16LEInterleaved
)
type Conn struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}

func NewConn(options ConnOptions) (*Conn, error)

func (c *Conn) Close() (resultErr error)

func (c *Conn) Connect(remoteID, token string) error

func (c *Conn) Disconnect() error

func (c *Conn) RequestVideoKeyframe(streamID uint8) error

func (c *Conn) SendCommand(commandID uint32, data []byte) error

func (c *Conn) SendStreamMessage(streamID uint8, timestamp time.Duration, data []byte) error

func (c *Conn) StartRecording(options StartRecordingOptions) (*RecordingTask, error)

func (c *Conn) State() ConnState

func (c *Conn) SubscribeAudio(streamID uint8) error

func (c *Conn) SubscribeVideo(streamID uint8) error

func (c *Conn) UnsubscribeAudio(streamID uint8) error

func (c *Conn) UnsubscribeVideo(streamID uint8) error

type ConnOptions struct {
	OnStateChanged  func(state ConnState, err error)
	OnCommand       func(commandID uint32, data []byte)
	OnStreamMessage func(streamID uint8, timestamp time.Duration, data []byte)
}

type ConnState uint8

const (
	ConnIdle ConnState = iota
	ConnConnecting
	ConnConnected
	ConnDisconnected
)
type EncodedAudioFrame struct {
	Data            []byte
	CodecConfig     []byte
	PTS             time.Duration
	SourceTime      time.Time
	Codec           AudioCodec
	BitstreamFormat AudioBitstreamFormat
	SampleRateHz    int
	Channels        int
	Discontinuity   bool
}

type EncodedAudioOutput struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}

func NewEncodedAudioOutput(options EncodedAudioOutputOptions) (*EncodedAudioOutput, error)

func (o *EncodedAudioOutput) Attach(connection *Conn, streamID uint8) (resultErr error)

func (o *EncodedAudioOutput) Close() (resultErr error)

func (o *EncodedAudioOutput) Detach() (resultErr error)

func (o *EncodedAudioOutput) State() OutputState

type EncodedAudioOutputOptions struct {
	OnFrame        func(frame EncodedAudioFrame)
	OnStateChanged func(state OutputState)
	OnError        func(err error)
}

type EncodedVideoFrame struct {
	Data            []byte
	CodecConfig     []byte
	PTS             time.Duration
	SourceTime      time.Time
	Codec           VideoCodec
	BitstreamFormat VideoBitstreamFormat
	Width           int
	Height          int
	KeyFrame        bool
	Discontinuity   bool
}

type EncodedVideoOutput struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}

func NewEncodedVideoOutput(options EncodedVideoOutputOptions) (*EncodedVideoOutput, error)

func (o *EncodedVideoOutput) Attach(connection *Conn, streamID uint8) (resultErr error)

func (o *EncodedVideoOutput) Close() (resultErr error)

func (o *EncodedVideoOutput) Detach() (resultErr error)

func (o *EncodedVideoOutput) State() OutputState

type EncodedVideoOutputOptions struct {
	OnFrame        func(frame EncodedVideoFrame)
	OnStateChanged func(state OutputState)
	OnError        func(err error)
}

type Error struct{ Code int32 }

func (e *Error) Error() string

func (e *Error) Unwrap() error

type InitOptions struct {
	AppID             string
	CacheDir          string
	Endpoint          string
	ConsoleLogEnabled bool
}

type OutputBufferOptions struct {
	Strategy           OutputBufferStrategy
	MaxBufferWatermark *time.Duration
}

type OutputBufferStrategy uint8

const (
	OutputBufferAutomatic OutputBufferStrategy = iota
	OutputBufferNoBuffer
)
type OutputState uint8

const (
	OutputIdle OutputState = iota
	OutputBuffering
	OutputDelivering
	OutputFailed
	OutputPaused
	OutputCompleted
)
type PixelFormat uint8

const (
	PixelNone PixelFormat = iota
	PixelI420
	PixelNV12
	PixelRGBA8888
)
type RecordingFile struct {
	Path     string
	Duration time.Duration
}

func (f RecordingFile) Delete() error
    Delete synchronously removes this Runtime-owned temporary media file.

type RecordingTask struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}

func (t *RecordingTask) Stop() (file RecordingFile, resultErr error)

type SnapshotFile struct {
	Path string
}

func (f SnapshotFile) Delete() error
    Delete synchronously removes this Runtime-owned temporary media file.

type StartRecordingOptions struct {
	VideoStreamID uint8
	AudioStreamID *uint8
}

type VideoBitstreamFormat uint8

const (
	VideoBitstreamNone VideoBitstreamFormat = iota
	VideoBitstreamH264AnnexB
	VideoBitstreamH265AnnexB
	VideoBitstreamMJPEGJFIF
)
type VideoCodec uint8

const (
	VideoCodecNone  VideoCodec = 0
	VideoCodecH264  VideoCodec = 65
	VideoCodecH265  VideoCodec = 66
	VideoCodecMJPEG VideoCodec = 67
)
type VideoDecoderPreference uint8

const (
	VideoDecoderAuto VideoDecoderPreference = iota
	VideoDecoderSoftware
	VideoDecoderHardware
)
type VideoFrame struct {
	PTS           time.Duration
	SourceTime    time.Time
	PixelFormat   PixelFormat
	Width         int
	Height        int
	Planes        []VideoPlane
	Discontinuity bool
}

type VideoOutput struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}

func NewVideoOutput(options VideoOutputOptions) (*VideoOutput, error)

func (o *VideoOutput) Attach(connection *Conn, streamID uint8) (resultErr error)

func (o *VideoOutput) Close() (resultErr error)

func (o *VideoOutput) Detach() (resultErr error)

func (o *VideoOutput) State() OutputState

func (o *VideoOutput) TakeSnapshot() (file SnapshotFile, resultErr error)

type VideoOutputOptions struct {
	DecoderPreference VideoDecoderPreference
	Buffer            OutputBufferOptions
	OnFrame           func(frame VideoFrame)
	OnStateChanged    func(state OutputState)
	OnError           func(err error)
}

type VideoPlane struct {
	Stride int
	Data   []byte
}
